# Interface texts

*This page is generated from the application; do not edit it by hand.*

<!-- Regenerate with: UPDATE_MANUAL_PAGES=1 cargo test -p stokesforge-app --lib manual_pages -->

You can switch the interface to French with **File ▸ Language**. This table helps you find an entry of the French interface from its English name, and the other way round. It lists:

- the menus and their entries, including the entries of the context menus (right-click);
- the titles of windows and dialogs;
- the names of the tabs of the graph settings and of the analysis categories;
- the names of the toolbars.

Texts that contain a variable (a name, a number) are not listed. A trailing "…" means that the entry opens a window. Rows are sorted by English text; a text used in several places appears once.
